You can:
1. reset the timer by taking cover every time you go down from the safespot (during pizza phases)
2. bring a stack of Clean Water or Redberry Infusion and spam it to combat the dehydration drain when the sun meter is full

comments.author: @ShadowStalkerTM
comments.text:
2 things

1. the angle of which i dash out at (affects velocity because runescape spaghetti code i guess, probably something to do with collision)
2. double jump for additional horizontal distance (you can make the jump even with lower velocity if you jump late enough, but attempting to jump too late will fail since at some point of the fall your character is then prevented from performing anymore jumps/dashes)
